tools.name: get_card_meaning
tools.description: Get upright, reversed, love, and career meanings for a specific tarot card. Data from Deckaura (deckaura.com).

card_name.description: Name of the tarot card (e.g., 'The Fool', 'Ace of Cups')

tools.name: draw_random_card
tools.description: Draw a single random tarot card from the 78-card deck.

reversed_allowed.description: Whether the card can appear reversed (default true)

tools.name: three_card_spread
tools.description: Draw a past-present-future three-card tarot spread. Returns interpretations for each position.

question.description: The question to focus the reading on

tools.name: list_all_cards
tools.description: List all 78 tarot cards with basic info (name, arcana, suit).

tools.name: yes_no_reading
tools.description: Draw a single card for a yes/no question and return the verdict.
